skill.name: Punctuating speech: marks, commas, new speaker new line
skill.why: Speech marks show readers exactly who said what, and when.
skill.how: Put marks around the spoken words. Punctuation goes inside. New speaker, new line.

steps.say: Indi here. Speech marks go around someone's exact words.

options.text: Single or double are both right, if you keep to one.

steps.win: Yes! Single or double, just keep to one style.

steps.say: Last one. Each new speaker gets a new line.
